description: Two monorepo fixture trees, each holding a Go, a Cargo, a TypeScript and a Python workspace. A file value is an array of lines (joined with newlines), an object (rendered as indent-2 JSON) or a raw string. Per target, deps lists the direct in-workspace dependency targets and own lists the inputs the target itself holds. The hand-authored closure of a target is common(ecosystem) + own + for each dependency: dep:<id> and that dependency's closure. A site names one single-character mutation: the span between prefix and until (searched after the optional after anchor) must occur exactly once. Input ids: source:<path>, config:<path>[#section], toolchain:<path>[#section], lock:<lockfile>#<entry>, dep:<target id>.
